name: Minesweeper Go
summary:
Pro version of a classic minesweeper game with online tournament, enjoy!

Minesweeper easily trains your brain and increases the speed of your thinking. At the same time, it is a fun and challenging logic puzzle!

The objective of Minesweeper is to demine minefields without detonating any of the land mines. Use flags to mark mines and tap numbers to open safe squares.

Are you an advanced player and want to beat Minesweeper records? Then you can leverage game options with flag and recursion chords.

Can you win all three classic minesweeper game levels? Then you are good enough to be listed in the World Rankings and to join the Minesweeper Community.

Minesweeper GO is free to play on android.

Whether you're a seasoned minesweeper or a curious novice, Minesweeper GO is the ultimate puzzle game for your android device just for free.

Download Minesweeper GO now and embark on an exhilarating journey of logic, strategy, and triumph!

Happy minesweepіng!
